name: Omori
tagline: Shinagawa in 9 minutes and Tokyo in 23 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 30 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 9 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 6.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 6.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.7 m to 16.7 m, a difference of 15.0 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at いすゞ病院, about 426 m away and 中島病院, about 918 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

neighbours.note: 681 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Omori.
1293 m away in a straight line. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Omori.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
